name: North Side Aces
description: The North Side Aces were formed in late 1972–1973 as a confederation of smaller corner gangs in Chicago's Lakeview neighborhood, organized by the Simon City Royals as a territorial expansion tool. Some younger Royals members (aged 15–16) were transferred to the Aces to provide a founding core. The gang carried automatic affiliation to the Simon City Royals and claimed territory running roughly from Ravenswood to Racine Ave. (west to east) and from just beyond Irving Park in the north to well beyond Belmont in parts to the south.
